description: This file contains an abstract class `StreamingResumeTests` which defines a series of unit tests for testing stream resilience and reconnection logic within an Orleans-based streaming system. The tests verify scenarios such as resume after inactivity, deactivation, and slow consumer conditions.

classes.name: StreamingResumeTests
classes.description: An abstract base class for testing streaming resume behavior in Orleans streams, including scenarios of inactivity, deactivation, and slow consumers.

methods.name: ResumeAfterInactivity
methods.description: Unit test verifying stream resume after a period of inactivity.

methods.name: ResumeAfterInactivityNotInCache
methods.description: Unit test verifying stream resume after inactivity with cache eviction.

methods.name: ResumeAfterInactivityImpl
methods.description: Implementation of the inactivity resume logic used by the above tests.

methods.name: ResumeAfterDeactivation
methods.description: Unit test verifying stream resume after grain deactivation.

methods.name: ResumeAfterDeactivationActiveStream
methods.description: Unit test verifying stream resume behavior when multiple streams are active and one is deactivated.

methods.name: ResumeAfterSlowSubscriber
methods.description: Unit test verifying stream behavior with slow subscribers.
